items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: also had the band at the Dreamland, because that's where I worked with him, the Dreamland Cafe, 35th and State.

ctx.x: Somewhere were Teddy Wilson played some intermissions, or --

No. I don't remember Teddy working with the Grand Terrace. I remember Teddy Wilson worked the Vendome with Erskine Tate, and also had the band at the Dreamland, because that's where I worked with him, the Dreamland Cafe, 35th and State.
